pages.text: Snow had fallen all night. Nono was the first one out in the alley. There wasn't a single footprint.
Nono wanted to leave footprints all the way to the end of the alley. "From here to the very end, all my footprints!"
Nono hopped along. A trail of little footprints appeared behind.
Some snow dropped from the roof. Nono fluttered up into the air.
Nono sat on the wall and looked around for a long time. Those little feet didn't touch the snow at all.
Nono came back down. The footprints stopped right in the middle of the alley.
Gugu and Kiki went past. The snow was all trampled, with no untouched white patches left.
Grandpa Badger was sweeping in front of his shop. "You have to walk to keep your footprints going," he said.
The next morning, it snowed again. Nono stood at the entrance to the alley.
This time, Nono walked all the way. The little footprints stretched right to the end of the alley.
